caption: The drawing features a wooden chest of drawers with three large drawers, each having a central keyhole and two round handles towards the outer ends. The wood is depicted in a rich, medium brown with visible grain, and each drawer front is smooth and rectangular. The sides of the chest are plain wood panels, while the corners on the front are decorated with ornate, vertically-carved spindle columns; the left column has twisted and spherical carvings, while the right column shows similar detailing. The chest rests on four short, rounded feet. The top of the chest is a flat, rectangular slab, depicted in a light grayish or white color with subtle marble-like veining. The entire piece is set against a plain, light beige background. In the lower right corner, there is handwritten text resembling a signature.
title: Chest of Drawers
